privacy.binding_notice: ⚠️ This is a summary translation provided for convenience. The legally binding version is the Italian one. Italian law and GDPR apply.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how RunHub ("we", "RunHub") collects, uses, shares and protects your personal information, and how you can exercise your rights. Compliant with {b_open}EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR){b_close} and the {b_open}Italian Privacy Code (Legislative Decree 196/2003 as amended by 101/2018){b_close}.
privacy.sec1_p:
The data controller is {b_open}RunHub{b_close}. For privacy questions or to exercise your rights:
• Email: support@apprunhub.com
• DPO: support@apprunhub.com
• Commercial info: info@apprunhub.com
privacy.sec2_p:
{b_open}Account data{b_close}: email, password (bcrypt hash), name, date of birth (to verify 14+ age).
{b_open}Profile data{b_close}: photo, weight, height, preferred sports, goals, level.
{b_open}Shared content{b_close}: comments, likes, posts, photos.
{b_open}Activity data{b_close}: distance, duration, speed, pace, elevation, GPS traces, heart rate from wearables.
{b_open}Geolocation{b_close}: GPS position during workouts (requires permission).
{b_open}Technical data{b_close}: device ID, IP, OS, error logs.
{b_open}From third parties{b_close}: Google/Apple Sign-In profile data, Apple Health/Google Fit/Health Connect (with consent).
privacy.sec8_p: The mobile app uses essential SDKs (auth, crash reporting). The website uses technical cookies (session, language preference) and, with consent, anonymous analytics. No third-party advertising cookies. More info in the website cookie banner.
privacy.sec9_p: RunHub is not intended for users under 14. If we learn of a user under 14, we delete the account. Parents/guardians can request deletion by writing to support@apprunhub.com.
privacy.sec10_p: We may update this Privacy Policy. For substantial changes we will notify you via email and in-app at least 30 days before they take effect.
privacy.sec11_p:
